samples.context: If I watch my diet, I will maintain good health. If I consume excessive junk food, I will become more susceptible to illnesses. We know that either I am committed to watching my diet or I am not prone to illnesses, but it is uncertain which of these statements is true. It is possible that I am only dedicated to maintaining a healthy diet, or alternatively, I may not be prone to illnesses, or even both statements could be true.

qa_pairs.question: Can we say at least one of the following must always be true? (a) i will stay healthy and (b) i don't eat too much junk food
Can we say at least one of the following must always be true? (a) i won't stay healthy and (b) i eat too much junk food
Can we say at least one of the following must always be true? (a) i will stay healthy and (b) i eat too much junk food
Can we say at least one of the following must always be true? (a) i won't stay healthy and (b) i don't eat too much junk food
